sloka: शक्तस्त्रैलोक्यमप्येको भोक्तुं किं नु महीमिमाम् ।नाऽस्य क्रोधः प्रसादश्च निरर्थोऽस्ति कदाचन ॥२-२-४५॥
transliteration: śaktastrailokyamapyeko bhoktuṁ kiṁ nu mahīmimām ।nā'sya krodhaḥ prasādaśca nirartho'sti kadācana ॥2-2-45॥

translations.english: His anger or favour never goes in vain. He kills those who rightly deserve to be killed and flares not at those whose life is to be spared.
